description: Geografische voorstelling van alle spoorsegmenten is a dataset listed in Infrabel open data portal, an open data portal of a railway infrastructure manager, published or maintained by Infrabel. Geografische beschrijving van alle spoorsegmenten op het Infrabel-netwerk, niet enkel hoofdsporen. Deze dataset is verbonden met de volgende datasets: Lijst en geografische voorstelling van de hoofdsporen: Lijst en geografische beschrijving van de hoofdsporen die een lijnnummer hebben. (bv: L50A). Kilometerpalen op het netwerk: Posities van kilometerpalen langsheen het spoorwegnetwerk. Coverage: Belgium. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Infrastructuur, Geolocatie. Its keywords are Sporen, Geolocalisatie, Hoofdsporen, Wijksporen, Bijsporen. The portal shows 2022-07-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open licentie CC0 - Universeel (https://infrabel.opendatasoft.com/pages/license/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-infrabel-open-data-portal.
